source: atlasopenmagic.get_all_metadata(), run on the Weizmann cluster analysis node (envs/atlas-pipeline, atlasopenmagic package), releases 2024r-pp, 2020e-13tev, 2025e-13tev-beta, 2025r-evgen-13tev, 2025r-evgen-13p6tev
query: physics_short containing 'LQ' (case-insensitive), scanned across all cached releases
note: Only release 2025r-evgen-13tev contains scalar-LQ PAIR PRODUCTION samples at mass points close to 400 GeV. No exact CMS-matching muon-decay M400 sample exists; the two M400 hits are both electron-decay.
conclusion: No exact muon-decay ATLAS scalar-LQ-pair sample exists at M=400 GeV in the cached atlasopenmagic releases. The closest exact-mass match (312117/312159, M400) decays to an electron, not a muon -- a genuine decay-mode mismatch versus CMS's LQToBMu_M-400_pair (42407). The closest ATLAS muon-decay LQ-pair samples bracket 400 GeV at M300 (DSID 310194) and M600 (DSID 312256), not at 400 GeV exactly.
